title: simple-kit
description: This plugin adds commands  to load or save kit. You also can enable combat for pvp.
body:
# SimpleKit

A lightweight PvP kit plugin for Paper servers.

## Features

* 6 customizable kit slots per player
* `/kit save <1-6>`
* `/kit load <1-6>`
* Combat tagging system
* 20 second combat timer
* Actionbar combat countdown
* Kits cannot be loaded during combat
* Combat logout protection
* `/combat on`
* `/combat off`
* Tab completion support
* Fast YAML-based storage
* Simple and lightweight

## Commands

### Kit Commands

* `/kit save <1-6>`
* `/kit load <1-6>`

### Combat Commands

* `/combat on`
* `/combat off`

## Compatibility

Tested on Paper 1.21+.

## Notes

This plugin is designed for PvP and practice servers that need a simple and clean kit system with combat protection.
